claim_summaries: For a complete traceless Hermitian Pauli involution basis, fixed-sandwich capacity is c(a), accessible information is O(1/d), and exact two-output broadcasting error is a*d/(4*(d+1)) by a Choi witness matched by the universal 1-to-2 cloner.

Every random-unitary instrument, through symmetrized instrument-append and Petz correction, yields an actually self-compatible Phi with ||Phi^m-D||_(infinity-to-1,tracial) <= 4^-m; quantum-expander gaps are unnecessary for this subclass.
LOCC data hiding is not a global-POVM EB lower bound; the symmetric/antisymmetric pair and any commuting noise-regularized version is exactly reconstructible and broadcastable.
The N61 symmetric-power ladder has diverging Holevo capacity and fails fixed sandwich; isotropic noise sufficient for the fixed upper sandwich forces its replacer error to vanish.
